input.prompt: Cinematic film still, 16:9, locked-off camera. A quiet modern web design studio at golden hour. A long dark oak desk enters from the right edge toward the centre; on it a slim monitor glowing softly with an abstract minimal website layout made only of pale rectangles, and a closed laptop. A single sharp shaft of low golden sunlight enters from a tall window on the right and cuts a diagonal band of warm light across a dark raw-concrete back wall; fine dust particles float and glitter inside the beam. The rest of the room falls into deep blue-black shadow. The left 45% of the frame is dark, calm concrete wall in shadow with almost no detail - clean negative space for a headline. 35mm film look, fine grain, gentle anamorphic softness, warm amber light against deep blue-black. No people, no readable text, no logos.
